bullets.text: patching a bike tube on the engawa. found the hole by ear before the bucket did. small competence, weirdly load-bearing today.
duck reached taisan-ji under light rain. watched steam leave the kettle, climb, bend, and fall back as more rain. 💧
the gutter settled into a pattern overnight — three quick drips, then one slow. hasn't broken step since.
even, slightly damp. a morning that asks for nothing and gets coffee anyway.
left shoe dried first. it always does. the right one is holding a grudge about something it won't name.
